en: Black‑and‑white historic postcard view framed by a stone archway, showing a cobbled square with horse‑drawn carts and people in early 20th‑century dress in front of a church wall with a large round clock. The church has a steep tiled roof and Gothic arched doorway. In the background are old town buildings with German signage. At the bottom margin is German caption text identifying the scene.
